value.rationale: The exact nondecaying subspace determines whether an open quantum two-particle experiment leaves a strictly positive long-time survival fraction even with arbitrary positive pair-loss strength. Parity removes all dark states on odd cycles, while on even cycles antipodal separation changes the usual universal 1/n overlap by a factor 2 or suppresses it entirely according to n modulo four. This is a meaningful exact boundary and structural selection rule, not a trivial reparameterization, routine low-order invariant, or general many-body extrapolation. The rank-one bright direction and momentum-pi flat band give reusable mechanics for related dissipative transport models.
